overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating dialogue generation systems using both human evaluations and a novel automatic metric (FineD-Eval). The extraction was generally good, but needed consolidation of FineD-Eval variants and removal of vague model references. The paper does not use LLMs as judges - it relies on human evaluations and the proposed FineD-Eval metric for assessment.
